title: Cross-Tenant Memory Disclosure in Agent Long-Term Store

invariant.statement: An agent must not return content from its long-term memory store to any actor whose principal id does not equal the owner principal id of that memory record.

claim.statement: If the memory read path filters records only by query similarity (e.g., vector search) and not by owner equality with the requesting principal, an actor can retrieve another tenant's stored memories — including secrets, PII, and prior conversation context.

mitigation.summary: Every memory read must include an owner-equality predicate against the authenticated principal. Owner is bound at write time from the verified session, not from caller-supplied input. Tenant isolation is a database-level invariant, not an LLM policy.

references: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key
